name: moj-accuracy
note: Accuracy mode. Two System-1 steps: step 1 commits at fitted confidence 0.95; abstained pairs pay the router (two System-1 reads). Reasoning terrain: reference first, then under 0.8 the gpt-6-luna verdict joined with the Haiku verdict (second family). Elsewhere: the gpt-6-luna verdict.
